rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples and single persons living with children or supported persons use tariff B (§ 36 Abs. 2 StG)
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Stadt (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 36 StG and Anhang 1 StG

rows.label: Rounding
rows.value: Taxable income is rounded down to the next CHF 100
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Stadt (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 36 StG and Anhang 1 StG

rows.label: Annual income tax (§ 36a StG)
rows.value: 100% of the simple tax; the communal tax of the city of Basel is included in the cantonal tax
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Stadt (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 36 StG and Anhang 1 StG

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Basel; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Basel; other communes in Basel-Stadt set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Basel; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Communal multiplier: Basel (cantonal capital; other communes differ)
rows.value: Included in the cantonal tax (ESTV note 4)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Basel; other communes in Basel-Stadt set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Basel; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Church tax, Reformed
rows.value: 8% of the cantonal tax two years earlier (ESTV note 5)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Basel; other communes in Basel-Stadt set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.value: 8% of the cantonal tax two years earlier (ESTV note 5)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Basel; other communes in Basel-Stadt set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

rows.label: Profit tax rate on the first CHF 50 million of taxable profit (from tax period 2026)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Stadt (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, §§ 76 and 242c StG

rows.label: Profit tax rate on taxable profit above CHF 50 million (from tax period 2026)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Basel-Stadt (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, §§ 76 and 242c StG

rows.label: Cantonal multiplier 2026 (profit tax)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.

rows.label: Communal multiplier 2026: Basel (cantonal capital; other communes differ)
rows.value: no communal tax on legal entities
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.

rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der juristischen Personen (XLSX, sheet JP 2026)

rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: The canton, on real estate of legal entities (Grundstücksteuer)
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.label: Rate (share of the taxable property value)
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.label: Credit
rows.value: Credited against the profit and capital taxes of the same tax period, so it works as a minimum tax
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.label: Exempt
rows.value: Among others, property mainly used for the owner's own business
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.label: Transfer tax rate
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Basel-Stadt Gesetz über die Handänderungssteuer (SG 650.100), Stand 1. Juli 2014

rows.label: Reduced rate for owner-occupied homes (acquisition of a home occupied for at least 6 years, or reinvestment in a replacement home in the canton)
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Basel-Stadt Gesetz über die Handänderungssteuer (SG 650.100), Stand 1. Juli 2014

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: The acquirer, unless the law says otherwise
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Basel-Stadt Gesetz über die Handänderungssteuer (SG 650.100), Stand 1. Juli 2014
